description: Source code defining the RemoteCluster model and related functionalities for managing remote clusters, including validation, encryption, and status checks within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: Bitmask
classes.description: Type representing bit flags for remote cluster options.

classes.name: RemoteCluster
classes.description: Represents a remote cluster with its configuration and status.

classes.name: RemoteClusterWithPassword
classes.description: Extends RemoteCluster with an associated password.

classes.name: RemoteClusterWithInvite
classes.description: Includes a RemoteCluster and an invite string, used for invitations.

classes.name: RemoteClusterInvite
classes.description: Represents an invitation to establish trust with a remote cluster, including encryption methods.

classes.name: RemoteClusterAcceptInvite
classes.description: Data structure for accepting a remote cluster invitation.

classes.name: RemoteClusterQueryFilter
classes.description: Filter criteria for querying remote clusters.

classes.name: RemoteClusterFrame
classes.description: Wraps a RemoteClusterMsg with remote cluster credentials.

classes.name: RemoteClusterMsg
classes.description: Represents messages exchanged between remote clusters.

classes.name: RemoteClusterPing
classes.description: Payload for ping messages between clusters to check connectivity.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of remote cluster fields for auditing.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares a RemoteCluster object before saving, generating IDs and sanitizing fields.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the RemoteCluster object.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Clears sensitive tokens from the RemoteCluster.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to a RemoteCluster object.

methods.name: IsOptionFlagSet
methods.description: Checks if a specific option flag is set.

methods.name: SetOptionFlag
methods.description: Sets a specific option flag.

methods.name: UnsetOptionFlag
methods.description: Unsets a specific option flag.

methods.name: IsValidRemoteName
methods.description: Checks if a remote name is valid based on length and characters.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Prepares a RemoteCluster object before an update.

methods.name: IsOnline
methods.description: Determines if the remote cluster is considered online.

methods.name: IsConfirmed
methods.description: Checks if the remote cluster is confirmed.

methods.name: IsPlugin
methods.description: Checks if the remote cluster is a plugin.

methods.name: GetSiteURL
methods.description: Returns the site URL or a placeholder if pending or plugin.

methods.name: fixTopics
methods.description: Ensures topics are properly formatted with single spaces.

methods.name: ToRemoteClusterInfo
methods.description: Returns a subset of remote cluster info for clients.

methods.name: NormalizeRemoteName
methods.description: Converts remote name to lowercase.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns audit information for RemoteClusterFrame.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates RemoteClusterFrame.

methods.name: NewRemoteClusterMsg
methods.description: Creates a new RemoteClusterMsg with a unique ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates RemoteClusterMsg.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a RemoteClusterInvite with a password.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted RemoteClusterInvite with a password.

methods.name: tryDecrypt
methods.description: Helper for decrypting with either PBKDF2 or scrypt.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates RemoteClusterInvite.
